planets.name: GJ 9827 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 9827 with a 6.2-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: GJ 9827 d was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around GJ 9827. Its orbit and size follow Piaulet-Ghorayeb et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
